ascend_skill.desc:
Tenebre Shoki can spend his own HP to gain Stellato stacks, increasing the skill damage of Scolpire.
When Tenebre Shoki gains a Blessing stack, change to Nocturnal Blessing.
Nocturnal Blessing: Counted as a special Blessing. At the end of the turn, gain a shield equal to 2% of max HP for 2 turns. Stacks up to 10 times. Shield granted lasts for 2 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Nocturnal Radiance

ascend_skill.desc:
At the start of battle, Tenebre Shoki gains Undying Starlight.
The first time he falls below 0 HP, spend Undying Starlight to restore 63% of max HP (restores to at least 1 HP) and increase Attack by 30% for 2 turns.
When using Steadfast Vow with Undying Starlight, Tenebre Shoki can reduce his own HP below 0 and enter a near death state. After this effect spends Undying Starlight, 2 Stellato stacks gained on the same turn can exceed the maximum limit.
When gaining Stellato, also increase critical rate by 5% and damage dealt by 5% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.
ascend_skill.name: Undying Starlight

ascend_skill.desc: Decrease HP cost of Steadfast Vow by 25%, and increase Attack by 25% for 2 turns. Increase maximum number of Stellato stacks by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Dazzling Stage

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Steadfast Vow and Scolpire by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Defying Darkness

ascend_skill.desc: Highlight Enhanced: Increase Attack by 35% for 4 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Trailblazing Will

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Blade of Dawn and Thief Tactics by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Blade Against Arrogance

ascend_skill.desc:
When Tenebre Shoki's HP falls to 0, he will not be KO'd and can continue with negative HP (down to a maximum of 100% of max HP. The activation conditions for Undying Starlight and minimum HP recovery become the maximum value of this effect.).
When HP is negative, enter the Nightlord state, and increase damage dealt by 35% and critical damage by 35%. Also, increase the skill damage increase effect of Scolpire from Stellato to 125% of its original effect.
Increase the maximum number of Stellato stacks by 3.
At the start of battle, gain 5 Nocturnal Blessing stacks that can exceed the maximum stack limit. These Nocturnal Blessing stacks are permanent.
ascend_skill.name: The Masks We Wear

highlight_skill.desc: Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 286.0%/315.3%/303.5%/332.8% of Attack. Based on lost HP, increase Highlight damage. Increase by a maximum of 60% when HP is at 40% or lower.
highlight_skill.name: Highlight

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 125.1%/137.9%/132.8%/145.6% of Attack, and increase Tenebre Shoki's critical damage by 48.8%/53.8%/51.8%/56.8% for 2 turns.
Gain 2 Nocturnal Blessing stacks. If Tenebre Shoki's HP is below 40%, gain 3 more Nocturnal Blessing stacks.
normal_skill.name: Blade of Dawn

normal_skill.desc:
Gain a shield equal to 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% of Attack + 1875/2472/2305/2933 for 2 turns (up to a maximum of 40% of max HP per skill use). Gain 1 Stellato stack.
After using this skill, Tenebre Shoki can use another skill in the same turn.
This skill does not count as a normal skill, and spends HP instead of SP when used.
Stellato: Increase damage dealt by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%. When using Scolpire, spend all Stellato stacks to increase the skill damage. Stacks up to 8 times.
normal_skill.name: Steadfast Vow

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 256.7%/283.0%/272.5%/298.8% of Attack. With 5 or more Nocturnal Blessing stacks, deal 1 more hit of Bless damage equal to 45.3%/49.9%/48.1%/52.7% of Attack. For each Stellato stack, increase this skill's damage by 12%.
After activating this skill, spend all Stellato stacks, and restore HP equal to 20% of Tenebre Shoki's max HP times the total number of Nocturnal Blessing stacks.
normal_skill.name: Scolpire

passive_skill.desc: For each Nocturnal Blessing stack, increase Attack by 6.0%.
passive_skill.name: Evening Starlight

passive_skill.desc: Increase pierce rate based on lost HP. Increase by a maximum of 15.0% when HP is 40% or lower.
passive_skill.name: Morning Starlight
